name: Salvatore De Meo - Considérant N - Am 12
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU agri-food promotion policy
part_text: N. whereas the EU promotion policy plays a pivotal role in supporting European exporters in accessing and consolidating new markets outside the EU, while also providing a strategic opportunity to promote European standards; whereas, against the backdrop of the ongoing conclusion of free trade agreements, it is essential to strengthen promotion policy as a strategic tool to enable European producers to take full advantage of opportunities to access external markets and to enhance the competitiveness and resilience of sensitive agricultural sectors facing increasing competitive pressure from imports from outside the EU; whereas free trade agreements on agricultural products, including with Mercosur, risk exposing European farmers to unfair competition that food promotion policies alone cannot offset;
